randall-putz.text: Housing platform: cut red tape for projects that include affordable units to speed development, convert vacant motels and offices into housing, and align growth with water, roads and public-safety capacity.
Housing platform: "expand safeguards to keep both renters and small landlords stable" and address rising rents.
Supports building more local clinics, recruiting doctors and mental health professionals through targeted incentives, and investing in telehealth backed by broadband.

source.title: Randall Putz for Assembly - Affordable Healthcare

randall-putz.text: Public safety: "target violent crime and drug trafficking while building trust between law enforcement and communities"; also pledges to hold law enforcement accountable to the highest standards.
Fair taxation: wants "big corporations pay their fair share so working families aren't left carrying the load alone," plus commuter tax credits or rebates for the High Desert.
Environment: pledges to clean up illegal dumping and hold polluters accountable; supports clean-energy projects that bring local jobs and community investment.
Public education: "I'll fight for smaller class sizes, more counselors and support staff," expanded career and technical education, and early childhood education.
Civil rights: pledges to strengthen anti-discrimination protections in housing, education and employment and expand support for vulnerable groups including LGBTQ youth.
Public safety plan supports infrastructure upgrades such as better street lighting and widened roads that prevent accidents and crimes; highlights highway safety on Routes 138 and US 395.
On renewable energy: "Desert communities should not be treated as sacrifice zones"; prioritizes disturbed lands over neighborhood areas.

source.title: Desert Trumpet - California State Assembly Districts 34 and 47 Primary Preview 2026

randall-putz.text: Endorsed by the California Democratic Party, California Teachers Association, SEIU California, Communications Workers of America, UAW Region 6, and San Bernardino County Professional Firefighters Local 935.
Endorsed by Planned Parenthood of Orange and San Bernardino County and Equality California.

charles-frederick-hughes.text: Priorities: oppose new taxes, a Middle-Class Tax Cut, and eliminating the state gas tax to lower fuel, grocery and housing costs.
Affordability priority: "Reduce overregulation and eliminating excessive government fees and costly mandates that drive up price increases"; cut red tape for small businesses.
Public safety priority: "Reinstating the death penalty, ensuring accountability for the most heinous crimes, including the murder of law enforcement."
Stands against efforts to defund the police, wants to protect the Peace Officer's Bill of Rights, and supports ending early release policies.
Wants to increase school choice for parents and expand vocational and trade programs; refocus classroom instruction on core subjects such as reading, writing and math.
"California needs more housing, but Sacramento's one-size-fits-all mandates are not working for rural communities."
